properties.notes: Allocation CR11g in Local Plan. Application 200188 for redevelopment of site for residential-led mixed use not yet determined, so figures from Local Plan used here.. Development should continue the high quality route including a green link from the north of the station to the Christchurch Bridge, with potential for an area of open space at the riverside. The main use of the site should be residential, although some small-scale offices and leisure will also be appropriate.. https://images.reading.gov.uk/2019/12/Local_Plan_Adopted_November_2019.pdf
